# Palocap — custom clothing in Milan since 1998

> Palocap is a shop in central Milan (Corso di Porta Ticinese 1, by the Colonne di San Lorenzo) that embroiders, prints and hand-paints t-shirts, hoodies, polos, caps and jackets to order. Founded in 1998. Minimum order: one piece. Walk-ins welcome; free quote in five minutes at the counter. Rated 4.9/5 on Google (31 reviews).

## What they do
- Embroidery (thread on fabric, own machines in the shop): hoodies, polos, caps and much more — permanent, does not peel or fade
- Print: t-shirts and hoodies with large designs and solid colours — best from about 10 pieces (teams, staff, events)
- Hand-painting: one-of-a-kind pieces, brush on garment — ideal for gifts
- Group / team uniforms since 2012: same design across garments and sizes (men, women, kids), different name or number on each piece
- Customers can bring their own garment or choose one from the shop
- Artwork: PDF or transparent PNG for printing; a hand drawing is fine for a hand-painted piece; the shop redraws logos if needed
- Palocap also makes its own branded hoodies and t-shirts under the Palocap label, sold in the shop
- Hand-painted pieces are also shown at https://www.notprinted.it
- Shipping: worldwide

## Practical
- Phone: +39 02 8901 2340 — Email: palocap@palocap.com — Instagram: @palocap_
- Porta Ticinese 1 (20123 Milano): Mon 16:00–19:00, Tue–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun closed
- Prices depend on garment, technique and quantity — ask for a free quote in person, by phone or by email
- Languages: Italian site at https://www.palocap.com/ — English site at https://www.palocap.com/en/
